method: span gate (all quotes in held bytes) + locate_claims (claim object names the trial) + value checks by hand

decisions.finding: VESALIUS-CV (PMID 41211925): its endpoint_definition_span is a BACKGROUND sentence ('The effect of evolocumab on the risk of MACE among patients without a previous myocardial infarction or stroke is unknown.'), not the held definition of its co-primary 3-point MACE.
decisions.amendment: Codex claimed the RESULT_INCOMPATIBLE refusal is wrong. Not accepted: VESALIUS's 3-point MACE is 'death from coronary heart disease, myocardial infarction, or ischemic stroke' -- CHD death, not cardiovascular death -- so a component-mismatch refusal may be correct. The established defect is only the wrong definition binding.

decisions.finding: FOURIER (28304224): the pooled value is the key secondary 3-component composite (0.80, 0.73-0.88; checked in outcomes[0].trials[0]) but its served endpoint_definition reads 'FOURIER: 5-point primary (adds unstable angina, revascularization)' -- the primary's definition on the secondary's number.
ODYSSEY LONG TERM (25773378) Injection-site reactions: served NOT_IN_HELD_SOURCES; the held abstract gives 5.9% vs 4.2%.

FOURIER (28304224) and ODYSSEY OUTCOMES (30403574) Injection-site reactions: reason_code_audit rows 3 and 4 verdict REASON_WRONG_KIND on the premise 'value absent from held source'; the held abstracts give 2.1% vs 1.6% and 3.8% vs 2.1%.

Comparator scope 'same-question comparator (matching intervention level and population)': the comparator's held full text admits 'placebo or standards of care' and tabulates OSLER-1 vs SOC; the protocol comparator is placebo only.

FIDELIO-DKD (33264825, a negative control in this topic): screening reason 'wrong population: title/conditions mention heart failure' -- heart failure is a component of the key secondary composite; the held population is CKD with type 2 diabetes. Exclusion stands on other grounds; the stated reason is false.
